rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poor-quality blastocyst with minimal/ill-defined blastocoel, absent/degenerate ICM, and disorganized TE consistent with 1DD; minor overinterpretation in calling overall cell number reduced and discussing collapse from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, FSH, endometrium, prior live birth and failures, male factor, semen parameters, and lifestyle with the embryo-grade-driven prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and consistent, with embryo morphology appropriately dominating prognosis; only minor issues include some speculative statements and broad probability framing.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading and standard IVF counseling: poor-grade blastocyst has low implantation potential, proceed if best/only embryo, review recurrent failure and consider selective PGT-A/male-factor workup; slight deviation in emphasizing PGT-A despite young age and low embryo yield.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer counseling, luteal support review, lifestyle optimization, prior-cycle audit, male-factor evaluation, stimulation review, and uterine reassessment if failures continue.
